ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISNEW(), $RecordType.Name='Invoice', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, 'Proforma Invoice')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, 'Initiate Tax Invoice')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Invoice_Status__c, '')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Invoice Status can only be 'Proforma Invoice' or 'Initiate Tax Invoice' for new Invoice
